title: BannerWriter
body:
# BannerWriter ✍️

## 👋 | Introduction
Ever had to experience the hassle of making signs out of banners when designing builds? Say goodbye to that! With this datapack you can easily make signs out of banners using a clicking system in the chat. Simply select your letter, banner/background color and the color of the letter, bam! You've got yourself a nice banner with a letter on it, simple as that!

## 📖 | How to use it

To use this datapack simply type /trigger writer or /trigger cbwriter for the colorblind writer.

### Difference between the Standard writer vs the Colorblind
The Standard writer has a more sleek and compact design for the colors by only showing the color and not name of the color while the Colorblind one says which color it is.

## 🧑‍💻 | For devs

<details>
  <summary>Forking this datapack 🍴</summary>
    
I strongly appreciate people forking this project to make their own versions of it but with a few "requirements".

**I would like for you to:**
- Mention that I'm the original creator.
- Include my README file.
- Share any forks with me (I would love to see them :D).
</details>

## 🚫 | Known issues
- When clicking on blank spaces in the menu it automatically registers it as the first option in the list (A or white).
